title: PtychoFM: A Foundation Model for Ptychographic Imaging
author: Aileen Luo, Emon Dey, Ming Du, Tao Zhou, Peco Myint, Himanshu Goel, Shashank Subramanian, Xiangyu Yin, Tekin Bicer, Sini\v{s}a Veseli, Cheng-Chu Chung, Jeffrey A. Klug, Aldo Pe\~na P\'erez…

excerpt: Ptychography provides high-resolution lensless imaging across X-ray, electron, and optical microscopy, but reconstructing images from diffraction measurements generally requires computationally intensity iterative phase retrieval. These methods often require experiment-specific analysis, limiting real-time feedback as data acquisition rates increase. Here, we demonstrate PtychoFM, a physics-aware foundation model for ptychographic imaging that combines large-scale pre-training with experiment-specific fine-tuning to reconstruct complex object images directly from individual diffraction patterns. Trained using a differentiable forward model without object-space labels, PtychoFM transfers from step-scan training data on one sample to fly-scan measurements of other samples with different feature sizes, morphologies, and refraction indices. At a synchrotron beamline, diffraction frames were streamed from the detector to a single GPU for inference at up to 200 frames per second and returned for real-time visualization. PtychoFM provides a practical route to rapid, transferable ptychographic reconstruction and live experimental feedback under nonideal conditions.
